get.description: Most recent application first by default. Filters combine with AND; offers without a value for the sort field come last.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text contained in the title, company or location, ignoring case. Blank is ignored.

parameters.name: appliedFrom
parameters.description: Only offers applied on or after this day, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

parameters.name: appliedTo
parameters.description: Only offers applied on or before this day, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Not before `appliedFrom`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only offers with one of these statuses; repeat the parameter for several (`?status=applied&status=interviewing`). All when absent.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Offers with no value for it (no application date, no company) come last. Statuses sort in the order of a search, `applied` first.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Sort direction. Default: `desc` for dates (most recent first), `asc` for text.

info.title: emploi API
info.description:
Job search history: the job offers the user responded to and the steps of their interview processes.

Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`): `type` names the kind of problem (`GET` it, e.g. `/problems/validation-error`, for what it means and how to fix the request), `detail` says what happened and what to do, and a `validation-error` lists every invalid value in `errors`, with its location, the rule broken and, when they help, the accepted values.
